fee_notes: Royalty: 5% or 4% of Gross Sales (5% for new restaurants/McOpCo sales as of Jan 1 2024; 4% for existing franchisees in certain circumstances). Advertising: minimum 4% of Gross Sales. Rent: Base Rent + Pass Thru Rent + Percentage Rent (6-29% of Gross Sales for new/relocated restaurants). Technology fees: annual ($47-$5,220) and one-time ($120-$2,600) for various systems. Satellite annual fee: $500-$2,500. Relocation contribution: $50,000.
